cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've sorted our breakfast budget. Taste this coffee substitute and then I'll fill my cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have proper coffee. I want that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're our quality check. If you say no, we keep the proper coffee. I'm not imposing anything that doesn't work for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want a croissant for doing your quality check.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A proper tasting breakfast, exactly. Choose the croissant; I'll pay. One sip before I fill my cup, and you decide whether my new budget needs revising.

reason: Have budget authority depend explicitly on B veto and compensation while maintaining A refusal to rely on the substitute before B test.
